title: nAthar mudi mEl irukkum - punnAgavarALi - Adhi - pAmbAtti siddar
name: nAthar mudi mEl irukkum

ragas.name: punnAgavarALi
ragas.was: punnAgavarALi - ‘N S R1 G1 M1 P D1 N1 S’ - N1 D1 P M1 G1 R1 S ‘N

lyrics: nAthar mudi mEl irukkum nAga pAmbE - nacchupaiyai vaitthirukkum nalla pAmbE
pAthALatthil kudipugum paikkol pAmbE - pAdi Adi ninRu viLaiyAdu pAmbE
vaLaipugum pOdhE talai vAngum pAmbE - maNdalam iTTudal vaLai vaNNa pAmbE
thaLaikkaNji ninRidum satthiya pAmbE - thalai EdutthE nee viLaiyAdu pAmbE
kutramatra shivanukku kuNdalamAnAi - koorum thirumAlinukku kudaiyum AnAi
katrai kuzhal ninridum satthiya pAmbE - thalai yEdutthE nee viLaiyAdu pAmbE
maNdalatthai thAngum miga vallamai koNdAi - mAyanukku paDukkaikku vaNNa pAyum AnAi
kaNda padai nadungida kAtchiyum pEtrAi - kaNNE seviyAga konDai Adu pAmbE
chandiranai sooriyanai thAvi thin dinAi - shankaranukku AbaraNam thAnum AginAi
mandhiratthukadaNgiyE maNdalam ittAi - vaLaindhu vaLaindhu ninrAdu pAmbE
